notes.title: 1.5 Update
notes.content:
HI guys 

It's been a year since I released this game on Steam, over time I updated it and fixed problems and reworked levels to make it more enjoyable, this game originally had a great reception when the demo came out but unfortunately once I released it it was not well received due to several problems with certain levels that were later remade and corrected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949265/ef217c6f1611b113e762d8c5d0ab851173528f6a.jpg[/img]

This is, as they say, the last major update that this game will have. I feel that after multiple corrections and level redesigns, I would have liked to have delivered it on day 1 of its release and I hope you can enjoy it.

[h1]FUTURE[/h1]

I am currently working on the sequel to Blue Maiden, which is also a sequel to my first game and completely closes the cycle of both games and resolves doubts that were not clear in the previous games. The demo is now available in case you want to play it. I plan to make this new project one of my best works to date.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3330930/Locked_in_my_Darkness_2_The_Room/


Thank you so much for your Support.

Blusagi Team
Fixed a bug that you get trapped in chapter 3

notes.title: Update 1.4 & Locked in my Darkness 2: The Room
notes.content:
Hi guys,

I wanna thank you for your feedback.

[h3]Blue Maiden Update 1.4:[/h3]

It has been many months of hard work and trial and error. first of all, I shortened the controversial chapter 3, which was hated and poorly received by the community, giving the game a bad image, therefore, I restructured the entire level, and added rooms to make it more enjoyable and make it feel much more like exploring also in chapter 2 I added some clues to find better the items to progress the game.

I hope this updated liked you.

[h3]Locked In my Darkness 2: The Room[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3330930/Locked_in_my_Darkness_2_The_Room/

I've been working on a new game that is a direct sequel to both my first game and Blue Maiden, the game is about the story of Taichi and Akane's daughter from my previous game, starting from the true ending of Blue Maiden, the game made with mechanics from scratch so I've been creating the new gameplay for months, I'm also using URP again which gives a realistic graphic level and good performance, I'm leaving some images so you can appreciate what the future game will be like.

notes.title: Update 1.2.7, Russian Language & Discord Rich Presence.
notes.content:
Hi guys 

This is the new update of Blue Maiden.

[list]
[*] Added Russian Language.
[*] Remaped Discord Rich Presence.
[/list]

Blue Maiden will have 2 more updates, after these updates the game will no have more support in future.

[h2]Future & beyond.[/h2]

First of all I want to make a reflection when I was developing Blue Maiden, the game got a good reception and good comments, that motivated me to accelerate the development and later launch it thinking that the game could be more successful than my first project, which I It was not like that, during these months after the launch very few people have been interested in playing it and that has demotivated me to continue making horror games, since I do not see interest from the community, I have been thinking that maybe I could try one more time in make a new horror game or just leave it, there are already many horror game developers who can easily replace me, in the same way the new game that I announced a long time ago that I was developing is currently paused because the lack of sales that I receive for part of my already released games that does not cover the development of the game I am doing.

I hope you understand me since without sales it is very difficult for me to continue making more games.

notes.title: Update 1.2.5 introducing the Japanese language, new ending, achievements etc.
notes.content:
HI guys

I have been working on bringing new content to the game and correcting certain things. With your feedback, many of your requests were that there be more endings in the game, which in this update was fulfilled by adding a new alternative ending different from the normal route depending on the path you take. the player chooses, in turn the other important thing is that the game now has the Japanese language, much of the theme of the game is inspired by Japan and many Japanese players who want to play the game are prevented by the language barrier so at the same time be a game with Japanese inspiration because it could not be missing that it was in the same language that saw the project come to life, now the game is completely translated into Japanese.

-Added Japanese language.
-Added a new ending.
-Chapter 4.1 was removed from the main menu.
-Added chapter 4.1 to a new ending route with a new subchapter.
-Added a new achievement for the new route.

Regarding the future, I am working on a new project, I hope to bring you news soon and, along with that, the new publisher that will be in charge of distributing it on both Steam and other platforms, stay tuned.

Greetings.

Blusagi Team.

notes.title: Blue Maiden is out
notes.content:
Hello guys.

The game is out, thank you very much for all your support over the months we have been polishing the game to make it a very immersive experience in terror.

I will talk a little of the game the game has 6 chapters which will take you into the neighborhood solving the riddle of the Blue Maiden, I also included secondary objectives in some chapters which will be rewarded with achievements if completed these are optional and can be omitted if the player wishes.

If you find a bug or error you can report it in the game forums or leave me a comment that I will gladly read them, also if you finish the game I invite you to please leave a review on the Steam page, as this helps me so that more people can see the game.

[h3]Future plans[/h3]

As you know the last update of Locked in my Darkness will be delayed until next year which is 1.8.6 and I will let you know when it will be released also we are going to have a discount for the anniversary month.

Blue Maiden will receive updates depending on the feedback from the community throughout the months.

Finally, the next game I'm going to make will be a little more complex because the plan with this one is to get a publisher because unfortunately the marketing I have done has not been enough to reach more players who love horror and I want more people to play and know my projects so I will raise the level of quality in my next game for a publisher to be interested in the project and support it, Among the plans is to open a Kickstarter and port the game to consoles with the help of the publisher, I hope to be achieved, therefore it is possible that there will be no new game soon.

Thank you very much for your support.

Blusagi Team.

notes.title: Blue Maiden Demo Release On October 9
notes.content:
Hi guys Long time no see you.

First of all I want to thank you for all the support that Blue Maiden has received throughout these months, the development of this second game has been easier compared to my first game, I applied a lot of the feedback I received from the first game to this second game and many things that I couldn't include in Locked in my Darkness I introduced in this second game, I hope you enjoy this demo since it inspires me a lot in Japanese culture, especially in games like Fatal Frame and the Chilla's Art saga. For this second game, I also want to clarify that this game is in the same universe as Locked in my Darkness, I hope you can find it. the references in this demo, without further ado let's get to the content.

[h3]The Demo[/h3]

This demo will contain Chapter 2 and Chapter 4 of the full game. The duration of this demo, depending on the player's skill, could take between 20 to 40 minutes to finish depending on the player's pace.

If you like it please add it to the wishlist On Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949265/78583d41ec36af2ec72182a208400eec81acf032.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Game[/h3]

My goal for Blue Maiden is to be 2 hours long, twice as long as my first game.

I want to thank you to my Beta Testers for testing the demo so early and Shaddy Unicorn for helping me to correct the English translation of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949265/c5436a308315ef626f96ed91d0e931761028542c.jpg[/img]

Thanks for everything and wait for more news soon, stay tuned.

Blusagi Team.
